entities.name: IgG accumulation in DRG and spinal cord

relationships.subject: CASPR2 autoantibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: the passive transfer of patient-derived CASPR2-Ab induces mechanical hypersensitivity in mice without overt neural injury

relationships.subject: CASPR2 autoantibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: CASPR2-Ab binds to mouse DRG neurons, reduces membrane-associated Kv1-channel expression, and increases sensory neuronal excitability

relationships.subject: FMS-IgG
relationships.evidence_quote: FMS-IgG promotes MRGPRX2/Mrgprb2-dependent mast-cell recruitment and IL-6 secretion

relationships.subject: FcRn
relationships.object: IgG accumulation in DRG and spinal cord
relationships.evidence_quote: FcRn blockade reduces IgG accumulation within the lumbar DRG and spinal cord after CCI

key_findings: Autoantibodies (CASPR2, plexin-D1, FGFR3, FMS-IgG, CRPS-IgG) drive pain via DRG neuron excitability, glial, mast-cell and Fc receptor mechanisms.
Pathogenicity depends on tissue injury and inflammatory context, and FcRn blockade reduces DRG IgG and established allodynia.
